newsitem.title: SWEDEN: POLL-Swedish current account seen 1.1 bln SKR May.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Swedish current account seen 1.1 bln SKR May.

text.p: Sweden's current account was expected to show a surplus of 1.1 billion crowns in May, a Reuters poll of 12 analysts found on Thursday.
Forecasts varied between a deficit of three billion crowns and a surplus of 4.9 billion cornws.
In April the current account showed a surplus of 5.1 billion crowns.
In May 1996 there was a surplus of 0.2 billion crowns.
The poll found 10 analysts on average expected the current account for full year 1997 to show a surplus of 49.4 billion crowns. Forecasts ranged from 42 to 56 billion crowns.
Last year the current account was in surplus 40 billion crowns.
The central bank, the Riksbank, will release the current account figures for May on July 21 at 1000 GMT.

Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aragon, Consensus, Den Danske Bank, Hagstromer & Qviberg, HSBC Midland, I.D.E.A., J P Morgan, Nomura, Nordbanken, Paine Webber, S-E-Banken, UBS and Unibank.
